page.overview:
What is Valmar?

Váli-màr, otherwise known as Valimar, the City of Bells, or Valmar, was the dwelling place of the Valar and their Maiar servants in Valinor, on the continent of Aman.

According to , Valimar was on the Girdle of Arda, west of Taniquetil.

The city was built on the great Plain of Valinor beyond the shield of the Pelóri, gated with great golden gates. It had gold domes, and streets paved with silver. Before the city's western gate lay the mound of Ezellohar, on which stood the Two Trees, and Máhanaxar, the Ring of Doom, were outside Valimar and between the city and the Trees. Valmar is generally considered the capital of Valinor, as it was there that the Valar congregated.

After being released from prison, Melkor lived here for a time, as he could not leave the city due to the Valar's mistrust of him.
